summary: Full frontend E2E of AppleBase 3D store (React TS + Vite, no backend). BUG FIX VERIFIED: all three horizontal rails (hero-product-rail, rail-hot-deals, rail-top-rated) scroll via (a) next/prev arrows (hot-deals: 0->888->0, top-rated: 0->888->0, hero: 0->280->0), (b) mouse pointer drag (0->272 for hot-deals/top-rated, 0->280 for hero), (c) carry data-lenis-prevent attribute so Lenis does not swallow wheel; drag does NOT navigate to /product and plain click DOES navigate (e.g. rail-card-iphone-titan-pro-max -> /product/iphone-titan-pro-max). Product page: all testids present (title/price/stock/specs/highlights/viewer-canvas 645x542/add-to-bag/buy-now/trade-in/back-to-store-link, gallery-thumb-3d + 0/1/2 switch between 3D and gallery-main-image). Cart: add-to-bag increments cart-count-badge 0->1, buy-now adds (badge->2) and triggers drawer flow, trade-in shows toast, back-to-store returns to /. All 5 GLB models load with HTTP 200 (iphone/macbook/ipad/watch/buds .glb) on their respective product pages; no console errors, only Three.js UV-set warnings and benign GL ReadPixels perf warnings. Storefront: category-tab-all=24, iphone=5, mac=5; deal filters hot=3/available=3/recommended=2; sort-select price-asc first=$30, price-desc first=$1,899; search 'watch'=3 results, 'zzzz' shows no-results-message. Cart drawer: cart-total $1,899, cart-remove works, cart-empty-message shown, checkout-express-button present. Theme toggle flips light/dark (verified visually - dark background applied) and persists across reload. Navigation from landing: nav-link-store scrollY=2089, engineering=3294, specs=6214 (Lenis). Responsive 390x844: 0px horizontal overflow on landing and product page, rail still visible. Scroll choreography sections all reachable (section-hero/features/showcase/specs + footer). No red console errors anywhere.

integration_issues.issue: URL changes to '/' but window.scrollY stays 0 after ~2.5s wait (expected to scroll to #specs after route transition). Likely a Lenis re-init timing race on route change. Works correctly when triggered from landing (scrollY=6214).

issues: Benign GL perf warning 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' (3x then throttled) - carried over from iteration 1, non-blocking.
THREE.GLTFLoader warnings 'Custom UV set 1 for texture map not yet supported' for all GLB files - cosmetic, model still renders. Could re-export GLBs with primary UV set only.

action_items: Optional: after route change from /product/:id to '/', delay nav scroll until Lenis is re-initialized (await next frame + lenis ready) so scrollY actually advances; currently stays 0.
Optional: re-export GLBs without secondary UV set to silence Three.js warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductRail.tsx correctly implements the three fix mechanisms (arrows via nudge, pointer drag with moved threshold>5px, data-lenis-prevent on the track, onClickCapture suppressing click after drag). Good separation and no leaks on pointerleave. LGTM.
loadModel.ts uses Draco + webp but GLBs still have duplicate UV sets - minor warning noise, consider cleaning in source models.

Theme persistence works but neither sets html.dark class nor data-theme attribute at the root; relies on CSS variables set elsewhere - fine but makes programmatic theme detection in tests harder (visual verification only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (10/10); 1 minor nav-after-route-change timing issue

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for horizontal rails is confirmed working. Use `window.__lenis.scrollTo(y,{immediate:true})` with 1.5-2s wait for vertical nav. For horizontal rails, assert on element.scrollLeft (not window). Theme is applied via CSS vars - verify visually via screenshot, not via html.dark class.
